name: Point of Trade Co.
notes:
Point of Trade Co. (AS50475) — a Middle East network hubbed in Kuwait,
serving cloud, hosting and connectivity across the GCC.

Peering policy: OPEN — no contract, no ratio requirement. We welcome
peering with networks of all sizes.

Where to meet us:
• Public peering at the Kuwait IX (bilateral or via route servers)
• Private interconnect (PNI) on request
• Regional & global IP transit available across the GCC and onward to Europe

RPKI ROA-signed and IRR-registered. Prefixes and IX peering details are
shared with peers on request.

Peering requests: peering@po-trade.com
